zh: 早上坏，欢迎来新写字楼、新办公室
en: Bad morning! Welcome to the new office

zh: 我知道早上上班的心情总是很艹蛋，因为我也是
en: I know Monday mornings always feel like absolute garbage. Trust me, I feel the exact same way

zh: 所以，新项目组的工作就全交给你了
en: Which is exactly why I'm handing over the entire new project team to you!

zh: 什么？你说你不会管人也不会取名字？
en: Wait, you don't know how to name or manage a program?

zh: 嗯……你要知道，把你招进来的时候，我对你是有很高的期望的
en: Well... I had extremely higher expectations for you when you're hired'

zh: 再说了，现在AI什么的不是很好用吗？有事问AI去吧
en: Besides, aren't AI tools all the rage now? Just go ask an AI

zh: 好了，我这边的游轮慈善晚宴都要开始了
en: Alright, my charity gala is about to start

zh: 好好学，好好干
en: Study hard, work hard

zh: 绩效好的话一切都好说，bye~
en: Get those KPI numbers up and everything will work out. Bye~

zh: 点击教程AI开始向上管理
en: Click the Tutorial AI to Managing-up

zh: 深挖同事剩余价值，赋能您的向上管理
en: Maximize peer surplus value, and empower your upward management.

zh: KPI宝，您最贴心的工作管家！
en: KPI Bao, your most thoughtful workplace assistant!

zh: 作为一个项目进度为“新建文件夹”的项目组的唯一成员
en: As the sole member of a project team whose current progress is literally "New Folder"...

zh: 您肯定也不想一个人干活吧！首先，您需要一些同事！
en: ...I'm sure you don't want to do all the heavy lifting alone! First, you need some coworkers!

zh: 您随时可以使用项目组的电脑！
en: You can use the team's PC anytime!

zh: 打开电脑的招聘系统，查看项目组收到的简历
en: Open the Recruitment System on the PC to view job seeker's resumes.

zh: 打开招聘面板
en: Open the Recruitment System

zh: 您可以拒绝或者同意雇佣这些求职者，雇佣他们需要消耗KPI
en: You can reject or approve these applicants. Hiring them costs KPI.

zh: KPI就是工作成绩~向老板提要求的权利~您未来的小钱钱~
en: KPI is your performance score — your leverage over the boss, and your future cash flow~

zh: 这几位是其他部门内推过来的，物美价廉，先凑活用吧！
en: These folks were referred from other departments — decent value for the price. They'll do for now!

zh: 点击同意将冰冷的简历变成温暖的人力资源
en: Click "Yes!" to turn a cold resume into a warm human resource.

zh: 现在，三位已经是您的同事啦！
en: Now, all three are officially your coworkers!

zh: 让同事闲着……啊不，没有工位坐就太不礼貌了
en: Leaving your coworkers idle... or rather, without a desk to sit at — how impolite!

zh: 把同事拖拽到工位上，同事就会开始为项目组工作啦！
en: Drag your coworkers to their desks and they'll start working for the team!

zh: 将同事拖拽到工位
en: Drag coworkers to their desks.

zh: 哦！您看，他们多可爱啊！他们工作着的样子就像是天使一样
en: Oh! Look at them — aren't they adorable? They look just like little angels when they work!

zh: 当然，作为老板的联系人，项目成果与您的辛劳密不可分~
en: Of course, as the boss's point of contact, the project's success is inseparable from your hard work~

zh: 出于为项目负责的心态，我们当然要敦促同事尽快完成工作~
en: In the spirit of project responsibility, we should naturally urge our coworkers to finish their work ASAP~

zh: 您可以右键点击同事，查看他们的当前工作进度
en: Right-click on a coworker to check their current work progress.

zh: 右键点击同事，打开同事面板
en: Right-click a coworker to open their panel.

zh: 当进度条走到终点时，同事就会产出一份文件
en: When the progress bar reaches the end, your coworker will produce a document.

zh: 左键点击同事。发送一条条期待，一条条敦促，提高他们的生产进度~
en: Left-click a coworker to send them encouragement and nudges, boosting their productivity~

zh: 连续点击同事，鼓励他们尽快完成工作
en: Click a coworker repeatedly to encourage them to finish their work faster.

zh: 一收到您的暖心问候，同事们工作进度实时飞涨
en: The moment your heartfelt greetings arrive, their work progress shoots up in real time!

zh: 显然，同事也感受到了您的热情，干劲更足了！
en: Clearly, your coworkers can feel your enthusiasm — and it's fired them right up!

zh: 多亏了您的努力，又一位迷途的同事悬崖勒马！公司的资产增加了！
en: Thanks to your efforts, another wayward coworker has been pulled back from the brink! Company assets increased!

zh: 由于老板不在家，公司的资产也约等于您的资产~
en: Since the boss is away, the company's assets are basically your assets~

zh: 您可以将这些资产用于许多地方，比如获取更牛的员工
en: You can spend these assets in many ways — like recruiting even better employees.

zh: 当进度条走到终点时，同事会产出文件！这是他们的工作成果~
en: When the progress bar completes, your coworker produces a document — the fruit of their labor~

zh: 同事的工作成果会被直接转化为您的KPI，同时也有一定概率产出资产
en: Their output converts directly into your KPI, and there's also a chance it generates assets.

zh: 产出的效率和数额与同事的属性相关，您只要查看他们的数据就明白了！
en: Output speed and quantity depend on your coworkers' attributes — just check their stats and you'll see!

zh: 既然都是为项目负责，您当然可以优化项目组的人员结构！
en: Since you're responsible for the project, you're absolutely entitled to optimize the team's structure!

zh: 查看您的人力资源中心，您可以在这里批量化地管理团队
en: Check your HR Center — you can manage the whole team in bulk right here.

zh: 打开人力资源中心，查看同事的工作状态
en: Open the HR Center to check your coworkers' work status.

zh: 被派遣的同事将出现在等待区，就像刚才那样，从天而降~
en: Dispatched coworkers will appear in the waiting area — dropping in from above, just like that~

zh: 如果等待区已经无处下脚了，优秀的同事们会进行自我管理
en: If the waiting area is full, your capable coworkers will manage themselves.

zh: 比如找点别的事情做，但这样他们就不会为我们产出KPI了
en: Like finding something else to do — but then they won't be generating KPI for us.

zh: 当然，您随时可以打开同事面板，再次将他们派遣到这个项目
en: Of course, you can open a coworker's panel at any time to redeploy them to this project.

zh: 或者让他们永久离开这个公司~这也是优化人员架构的必不可少的一环
en: Or let them permanently leave the company~ That's an essential part of optimizing your team structure.

zh: 表现很突出嘛。项目才开张了多久，就做出了一点成绩
en: Impressive. The project's barely started and you've already made some progress.

zh: 很好，现在你攒够了绩效，可以申请提升职级了
en: Good. You've accumulated enough KPI now — you can apply for a promotion.

zh: 打开升级界面，查看晋升机会
en: Open the Upgrade screen to view your promotion options.

zh: 消耗您积累的KPI，晋升为一颗更稳固的螺丝钉
en: Spend your accumulated KPI to get promoted — and become an even more indispensable cog in the machine.

zh: 升级之后，你掌握的资源就更多了，但也意味着之后的任务就更艰巨了
en: With the promotion comes more resources — but also tougher challenges ahead.

zh: 加油，我一直是很看好你的，这对你来说是一种栽培
en: Keep it up. I've always believed in you — think of this as me investing in your growth.

zh: 好好学，好好干，bye~
en: Study hard, work hard, bye~

zh: 除了更好和更多的工位，现在您可以使用办公室来激励同事工作了！
en: Beyond better and more desks, you can now use offices to motivate your coworkers!

zh: 空置的办公室只能拿来堆纸箱。快给它选择一个功能吧！
en: An empty office is just a place to stack cardboard boxes. Give it a function already!

zh: 点击办公室，为办公室分配职能
en: Click on an office to assign it a function.

zh: 选择茶水间作为这间办公室的职能
en: Select Pantry as the function for this office.

zh: 享受到了员工福利的同事显然更有干劲了！
en: Coworkers who enjoy employee perks are clearly more motivated!

zh: 积攒更多KPI提升职级，您将解锁更多的办公室和办公室功能！
en: Accumulate more KPI and level up to unlock more offices and office functions!

zh: 考虑到您日理百机，忘掉这些操作也是非常正常的
en: Given how busy you are, forgetting all this is completely understandable.

zh: 您随时可以查看职场手册，一键恢复记忆
en: You can check the Workplace Manual anytime to refresh your memory in one tap.

zh: 至于为什么不是问我？那当然是因为：节约token是AI的传统美德
en: Why not just ask me instead? Simple — conserving tokens is a time-honored AI virtue.

zh: 那么，我先去培训其他工贼……啊不，工作人员了！
en: Anyway, I'm off to train the other workplace thieves — I mean, staff members!

zh: KPI宝，您最贴心的工作管家
en: KPI Bao, your most thoughtful workplace assistant.

zh: 更懂职场，更懂您！
en: We know the workplace. We know you.

zh: [左键] 继续对话 | 长按 [空格] 跳过
en: [LMB] Continue | Hold [Space] to Skip

zh: 总感觉怪怪的你再改改
en: Something feels off

zh: 快打包了什么时候做完啊
en: When are you finishing this?

zh: 老师这就是成图了吗
en: Is this really the final version?
